title: Freshman Primer
prompt: Explain it to a first-year student with zero technical jargon.
description: Break down complex concepts into fundamental intuitive metaphors.

title: Cricket Pitch Analogy
prompt: Explain it using a cricket analogy.
description: Map components, roles, and rules to bowlers, batsmen, overs, or fielding strategies.

title: Boardroom Elevator Pitch
prompt: Explain it to a Fortune 500 CEO in 60 seconds flat.
description: Focus strictly on business impact, ROI, efficiency gains, and risk mitigation.

title: Zero Jargon Lockdown
prompt: Explain it without using ANY technical acronyms or buzzwords.
description: Banned words include: Algorithm, Cloud, Framework, Model, Pipeline, Token.

title: Real-World Grounding
prompt: Explain it using a tangible everyday consumer product.
description: Connect the architecture to how an ATM, microwave, traffic light, or delivery app operates.

title: The 2031 Vision
prompt: Explain why this technology will fundamentally reshape society in the next 5 years.
description: Highlight future bottlenecks, geopolitical stakes, and societal impact.

title: Bedtime Fable
prompt: Explain the concept using a fictional story with characters and conflict.
description: Turn components into characters solving a crisis in an imaginary world.

title: Security Devil's Advocate
prompt: Explain this technology by describing how a malicious actor would try to exploit it.
description: Highlight the defense mechanisms by detailing attack vectors and mitigations.

title: School Kid Curiosity
prompt: Explain it as if answering a persistent 10-year-old child asking 'Why?'.
description: Anticipate basic questions with simple, vivid, concrete physical examples.

title: The Failure Autopsy
prompt: Explain the technology through the lens of a catastrophic system failure.
description: Illustrate why the technology was invented by describing what breaks without it.

title: Restaurant Kitchen Metaphor
prompt: Explain the architecture as a busy restaurant kitchen operation.
description: Map servers, queues, databases, and workers to chefs, orders, pantries, and runners.

title: Mythbusters Breakdown
prompt: Bust 2 widespread myths about this technology and reveal the ground reality.
description: Separate media hype from engineering reality.
